candidates.name: reduce_contact_penalties
candidates.hypothesis: Increasing the collision high penalty will discourage aggressive driving.
candidates.rationale: By increasing the collision high penalty, agents will be more likely to avoid contacts, thereby improving race quality.

candidates.name: increase_overtake_bonus
candidates.hypothesis: Increasing the overtake bonus will promote cleaner overtaking behavior.
candidates.rationale: A higher overtake bonus encourages agents to execute overtakes more systematically, leading to fewer collisions.

candidates.name: steer_smoothness_penalty_adjustment
candidates.hypothesis: Increasing the steer smoothness penalty will help agents maintain better control over corners.
candidates.rationale: A higher steer smoothness penalty may lead to smoother steering and reduced contact issues.
